data.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
data.detailed_description:
Ultimate Edition


The Red Dead Redemption 2: Ultimate Edition delivers all of the Story Mode content from the Special Edition plus additional content for online including Bonus Outfits for your online Character, Rank Bonuses, Black Chestnut Thoroughbred and free access to the Survivor Camp Theme.

Plus get free access to Additional Weapons in online.


Acerca do jogo

América, 1899. Arthur Morgan e o bando Van der Linde estão em fuga. No seu encalço têm agentes federais e os melhores caçadores de prémios da nação. O bando terá de assaltar, roubar e abrir caminho para sobreviver no agreste centro da América. Quando os conflitos internos ameaçam destruir o gangue, Arthur terá de escolher entre seguir os seus próprios ideais ou o bando que o viu crescer.

Vencedor de mais de 175 prémios de Jogo do Ano e 250 pontuações perfeitas, Red Dead Redemption 2 é uma história épica de honra e lealdade na aurora da era moderna.

Red Dead Redemption 2 inclui ainda o Red Dead Online — uma experiência multijogador no mundo de Red Dead Redemption 2 — explora a sós ou com o teu bando, gere a tua própria destilaria ilegal; enfrenta as forças da lei, bandos rivais, animais ferozes e muito mais, à medida que forjas o teu destino na fronteira americana.

reviews.review:
[h1] Red Dead Redemption 2 – An Artwork You Can Live Through [/h1]

There are games you just play.
There are games you remember.
And then there are those that change something inside you.

[b]Red Dead Redemption 2[/b] is not just a game. It’s a [b]moment in life.[/b]

You might see it as just another action-packed cowboy adventure, expecting shootouts, chases, and crime. But the longer you spend in this world, the more you realize—this is not just entertainment. It’s a [b]true work of art.[/b]

Nobody is rushing you here.
There is no need to sprint towards the finale.
This is a story that slowly weaves itself into your own perception.

[b]And if you let it, it will stay with you forever.[/b]

[h2] 🌄 A World That Lives Without You [/h2]

You can leave. Walk away.
Close the game and forget about it for a month, a year.

But when you return—[b]it will still be here.[/b]

The lights in the city windows will still burn through the night.
Somewhere beyond the horizon, a man will still be strumming an old tune on his guitar.
The wind will still be carrying dust across the endless plains.

You can [b]become part of this world,[/b] influence it. But you will never be [b]its center.[/b]

This is not your typical "open-world game" overloaded with icons and mindless activities.
This is a [b]world that follows its own rules.[/b]

You can spend hours simply riding forward, watching the sun rise behind the mountains, a herd of wild horses galloping through the fields, or a lone traveler sharing his story, not even knowing who you are.

[b]And that is what makes it alive.[/b]

[h2] 🎭 Characters That Feel Like People [/h2]

Every person you meet could be just another face in the crowd.
But if you stop, listen, talk—you will uncover [b]a real life.[/b]

✅ Someone might simply ask for help.
✅ Someone might share a story that sounds oddly familiar.
✅ Someone might remember you and greet you hours later, recalling everything you did.

[b]Red Dead Redemption 2[/b] doesn’t give you [b]"heroes" and "villains".[/b]
It simply presents [b]people as they are.[/b]

And that’s why [b]they stay with you.[/b]

[h2] 🔫 Gameplay – You Shape It [/h2]

[b]Nothing here is just a "feature."[/b]
Every action isn’t just a mechanic—it’s a [b]piece of your story.[/b]

✅ [b]Gunplay[/b] isn’t just about aiming—it’s about the weight of the weapon and the gravity of each shot.
✅ [b]Horses[/b] aren’t just "transport"—they are [b]companions[/b] who remember you and can be lost forever.
✅ [b]Combat[/b] isn’t a "cinematic shooting gallery"—it’s brutal, unpredictable, and [b]every mistake has consequences.[/b]

You don’t [b]"play as a character."[/b]
You [b]live their life.[/b]

[h2] 🎵 Atmosphere & Music – The Heartbeat of This World [/h2]

The music in [b]Red Dead Redemption 2[/b] doesn’t just enhance the game.
It [b]guides you through it.[/b]

You won’t notice how [b]a quiet guitar piece stays in your head.[/b]
How [b]an old tune will resurface[/b] at the most unexpected moment.
How [b]silence can say more than any song.[/b]

And when the world stands still, when you find yourself alone among the hills, listening to nothing—[b]that’s when you realize it’s the loudest music of all.[/b]

[h2] 🛒 Should You Buy It? [/h2]

❌ [b]If you’re looking for quick thrills – no.[/b]
❌ [b]If you just need a game to check off your list and move on – no.[/b]

But if you want to [b]live through a real story, experience a world that breathes, and leave a piece of yourself in it[/b] – [b]this game will stay with you forever.[/b]

🔥 [b]Emotions that never fade[/b] – 10/10
🌎 [b]One of the most immersive worlds ever created[/b] – 10/10
🎭 [b]Characters that will stay in your memory[/b] – 10/10

[b]Red Dead Redemption 2 doesn’t rush you.[/b]
It simply offers you a chance [b]to stop and take it all in.[/b]

[b]The only question is—are you ready to see it?[/b]
